subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this issue remain the canonical umbrella for Anthropic signed-thinking replay until the remaining prevention and recovery-carrier PRs are resolved, or should maintainers move the canonical remaining work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 now?
rationale: The merged recovery slices are real, but the remaining fixes intentionally change provider replay semantics and overlap multiple open PRs; automation should not choose the final canonical scope or replay policy.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Canonical
options.body: Leave this issue open until the focused prevention and terminal-result recovery work lands or is rejected, preserving the broader production evidence in one place.

options.title: Move To Focused Issue
options.body: Close this issue as superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 only after posting a handoff that preserves the remaining recovery-carrier context.

options.title: Backport Recovery Only
options.body: Treat the merged recovery slices as sufficient for now and defer replay-prevention policy to a later provider review.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Canonical
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until the focused prevention and terminal-result recovery work lands or is rejected, preserving the broader production evidence in one place.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest routing candidate from the current history and discussion for the Anthropic replay-policy tradeoff.
